# Edge profile from one slanted edge of an Image Engineering UTT A3,
# module BR, vertical, linearised through the
# capture's Adobe RGB profile and binned at 0.25 px.
# 
# Committed because the defect it pins cannot be built from a synthetic
# edge: a synthetic ESF has perfectly flat plateaux, so the median of its
# LSF tails is zero and the step that used to sit before the window was a
# no-op. On this profile that median is -1.348e-04, and subtracting it moved
# the DC normaliser enough to scale the whole MTF curve by 1.12.
# 
# 427 values, one per bin.
